recognize_zh: 這是嬰兒全身正面 X 光（infantogram）：脊椎、顱底與長骨都呈均勻高密度，椎體可見骨中骨（bone-within-bone）樣輪廓；配合骨髓切片的硬化與纖維化，符合嬰兒型骨質硬化病。
features: Whole-body AP radiograph of an infant
Diffusely increased bone density involving the spine, skull base, pelvis and long bones
Uniformly dense vertebral bodies with a bone-within-bone appearance
Dense, sclerotic skull base and orbits
Protuberant abdomen; image resolution limits assessment of fine bony detail
describe_en: Whole-body anteroposterior radiograph (infantogram) shows generalized increased skeletal density affecting the axial and appendicular skeleton, including uniformly dense vertebral bodies with a bone-within-bone configuration and a sclerotic skull base. The abdomen appears protuberant, although organomegaly cannot be assessed reliably on this image, and fine trabecular detail is limited by resolution. Together with marrow osteosclerosis, paratrabecular fibrosis and reduced hematopoiesis on biopsy, these findings are consistent with infantile (malignant) osteopetrosis, which causes marrow failure and extramedullary hematopoiesis.

ddx.vs: Pycnodysostosis shows dense bones with acro-osteolysis of distal phalanges, open fontanelles and short stature, without marrow failure.

ddx.dx: Transplacental/metabolic sclerosis (e.g., hypervitaminosis D, heavy metal)
ddx.vs: These produce dense metaphyseal bands rather than uniform diffuse sclerosis with bone-within-bone vertebrae.
